**Observation Log:**

- [PREFERENCE] The user is interested in mindfulness apps to help stay focused and avoid distractions.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Freedom helps block distracting websites and apps across all devices, allowing customization of block sessions.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Calm provides guided sessions, sleep stories, and relaxing music.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Moment tracks screen time and offers guided meditation sessions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Forest gamifies productivity by growing a virtual forest as users stay focused.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Focus@Will provides background music designed to help concentration.
- [PREFERENCE] The user is considering using Freedom to block social media during certain hours.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided a step-by-step guide for customizing block sessions on Freedom.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The steps include opening Freedom, creating a new block session, choosing devices, selecting a block list, setting block duration, scheduling the block, adding exceptions, and saving the block.
